name: Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney – Presumption of Guilt
storyline: Only a few months after the infamous Matt Engarde trial Phoenix Wright finds himself with a new client, things seems straightforward right? Well as always there's always the bigger picture... No sooner has one case been completed than another one arises however things seem a bit more complicated this time as Phoenix finds himself without the usual help he gets...
summary:
Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney – Presumption of Guilt is a fangame based on the Ace Attorney series.

It serves as an interquel between the second and third mainline entries in the series — Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney – Justice for All and Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney – Trials and and Tribulations. Six cases are currently planned for the game.
